scenario.note: Limits the proportion of undamaged cars at Glasgow depot in the morning to 15% of all undamaged cars.
The share of undamaged cars at Glasgow depot in the morning cannot exceed 15% of the total undamaged cars.
The rule enforces that the total damaged cars at the depot in the morning is at least three times the total cars repaired.
The rule ensures that the total number of damaged cars at all depots in the morning is at least three times the total number of cars repaired.
